    SHARE

    Our client, a leading organization in the electronics and engineering industry, is seeking a Failure Analysis Engineer I to join their team. As a Failure Analysis Engineer I, you will be part of the Engineering Department supporting the failure analysis and troubleshooting of electronic circuits. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong communication skills, a quick learning ability, and self-motivation, which will align successfully in the organization.

    Job Title:Failure Analysis Engineer I

    Location:Los Angeles, CA

    Pay Range:$32

    What's the Job?

    • Perform troubleshooting and failure analysis of electronic circuits, including both analogue and digital components.
    • Understand and interpret schematics and circuit functions to identify issues.
    • Design, build, and assemble prototype circuits for testing and validation purposes.
    • Document quality issues and performance metrics for management review.
    • Coordinate with external vendors as needed to support failure analysis activities.

    What's Needed?

    • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electronics Engineering (Master's degree is also acceptable).
    • 0-3 years of relevant experience; training will be provided for entry-level candidates.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Access.
    • Knowledge of common failure modes of electronic components and assemblies.
    • Strong soft skills, including excellent verbal and written communication, fast learning, and self-motivation.

    What's in it for me?

    • Opportunity to develop skills in electronic failure analysis and troubleshooting.
    • Work in a dynamic and supportive team environment.
    • Potential for career growth and development within the organization.
    • Engage in meaningful projects that impact product quality and reliability.
    • Relocation at own expense is acceptable for the right candidate.

    Upon completion of waiting period, consultants are eligible for:
